# Test recordings

- `jfk.wav`: John F. Kennedy's 1961 inaugural address excerpt (public domain, US government work), as distributed in [whisper.cpp `samples/jfk.wav`](https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp/blob/master/samples/jfk.wav).
- `botchan-opening.mp3`: first 34 seconds of 坊っちゃん (Botchan) chapter 1 by Natsume Sōseki, [LibriVox recording](https://archive.org/details/botchan_1310_librivox) (public domain), cut without re-encoding.
